description: Parses natural language text to quickly create a basic Google Calendar event with its title, date, and time, suitable for simple scheduling; does not support direct attendee addition or recurring events, and `calendar_id` must be valid if not 'primary'.

calendar_id.description: Identifier of the calendar for the event. Use 'primary' for the main calendar, or provide a specific calendar ID (e.g., email address).
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The calendar where you want this event to be created. Use 'primary' for your main calendar, or provide a specific calendar ID or email address.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

send_updates.description: Controls whether email notifications about the event creation are sent to attendees.
send_updates.human_parameter_description: Choose whether attendees should receive email notifications when the event is created. Select 'all' to notify everyone, 'externalOnly' to notify guests outside your organization, or 'none' for no emails.
send_updates.title: Send Updates

text.description: Required natural language input describing the event. It must contain at least one non-whitespace character. Google Calendar parses it for event details like title, date, and time.
examples: Dentist appointment tomorrow at 2pm for 45 minutes
text.human_parameter_description: Describe the event in plain language (e.g., 'Lunch with Alex tomorrow at 12pm'). Google Calendar will parse this to set the title, date, and time.
text.title: Text
